guard_cases: a changed test maps to itself
a source maps by class_name (word match) and by test_<basename> twin
a source maps by res:// path mention
shared inputs force the full suite and say why (support, project.godot, .gutconfig.json, addons, data/schemas, tests/load_all.gd)
outside project/ needs no unit tests; .uid is ignored
a deleted test is a note, not a failure
a word-boundary miss does not map
an unmappable project file forces the full suite (kept FULL; reason text changed to 'unreferenced asset <path>' for non-.gd, 'no test mentions it' kept for .gd)
deviations_from_card: (1) Autoload scripts (project.godot [autoload]: Log, LaunchArgs, Events, Game, Data, Save, Platform) map FULL: GUT boots every autoload for every test, so the one-hop rule would under-select (boot/game.gd mapped to 2 tests). Not in the card; it costs 13 FULL commits in the replay (11 -> 24), mostly boot/launch_args.gd (14). (2) An asset maps through its referrers with the referrer treated as a changed source (direct + one hop), and non-.gd referrers (scenes, tables) recurse up to 3 levels; data/tables/*.json are reference sources too (they hold res:// art paths). (3) A one-segment ancestor dir ('res://', 'res://features/') never counts as a reference. (4) run_unit.mjs unchanged: realIndex().reach is a lazy getter, so only --changed/mutate pay the ~3 s build; mutate inherits the reach automatically. (5) One commit, not a test/feat series: the test commit alone would be red (module missing). (6) --history keeps only paths that still exist (the index is today's tree) for both Before and After. (7) Unknown test_map flags exit 2.

shared_lines.AGENTS.md: | `node tools/tests/test_map.mjs [<paths>] [--why=<test>] [--history[=600]]` | | what `--changed`/mutate select and why: res:// refs (exact or nearest ancestor dir), tables, class/autoload names plus one dependent hop (`tools/tests/reach_index.mjs`, `reachOf(changed, index)` -> per-test chains); `--why` prints the chain (exit 1 not reached); `--history` replays the last N non-merge commits (FULL share, mean files). dev/ nothing names and tests/scenarios map to no unit tests; autoloads, schemas, support and unreferenced assets stay FULL |
shared_lines.docs/decisions.md: - [2026-11-07] DECISION test-suite: test_map selects through a derived reach index (res:// literals incl. ancestor-directory constants, class_name/autoload names, one dependent hop) instead of text mention only; autoload scripts and unreferenced assets stay FULL (conservative). Replay of 600 commits: FULL 57% -> 15%, mean files 200 -> 67.1. Rejected: full transitive closure (through the composition root most files reach most tests) and an observed GUT load map (attribution unproven).
